system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Simon Peter, a fisherman in a plain wool tunic and fringed cloak, standing apart near the gateway","action":"Peter turns his head toward the darkened courtyard and sinks to his knees, face lowered in anguish, weeping bitterly as he recalls the words he heard","setting":"Covered porch and gateway of the high priest's courtyard in Jerusalem, stone paving, cool night air, the street visible beyond the gate","secondaryElements":"Brazier glowing low with embers, servants and a Temple guard turned away in the background, oil lamps on the walls, pale grey dawn light beginning at the open gateway","mood":"Sorrowful, intimate, remorseful, quiet grief within a tense gathering","timeOfDay":"Last hour before dawn, deepening to first grey light at the gateway","composition":"Peter in the lower left foreground kneeling, the brazier glow behind him, the dawn-lit gateway opening on the right, diagonal sweep leading the eye from courtyard to light"}
